title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
authors_zh: Rafael Rafailov、Archit Sharma、Eric Mitchell、Christopher D. Manning、Stefano Ermon、Chelsea Finn（斯坦福大学）
paper_type_zh: 直接偏好优化与成对偏好数据训练研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要理解偏好对如何直接进入模型对齐训练的读者。
one_line: DPO directly optimizes a policy from chosen/rejected preference pairs using a reference-policy likelihood ratio.
DPO 用参考策略的似然比直接从优选/拒选回答对优化模型，无需单独训练奖励模型。
why: It is the standard training consumer against which later preference-data selection and construction work is usually evaluated.
inclusion_reason: Establishes a direct objective for consuming pairwise preference records without fitting a separate reward model.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLHF normally turns pairwise preferences into a reward model and then trains a policy against that learned reward. This separates the training records from the final objective through an additional model and an online reinforcement-learning loop, adding instability and implementation cost.

DPO asks whether chosen and rejected responses can train the policy directly while retaining the constrained-reward interpretation of RLHF. It derives a classification-style objective in which each preference pair changes the policy relative to a fixed reference policy.

RLHF 通常先将成对偏好转化为奖励模型，再让策略针对学习到的奖励训练。这会通过额外模型和在线强化学习循环，使训练记录与最终目标间接相连，并增加不稳定性和实现成本。

DPO 追问能否直接用优选和拒选回答训练策略，同时保留 RLHF 的受约束奖励解释。它推导出分类式目标，使每条偏好对都相对于固定参考策略改变策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper uses the mapping between an optimal policy and its reward function to reparameterize the reward. The resulting preference probability depends on the policy's log-likelihood ratio to a reference policy for the chosen and rejected answers.

Training simply raises the relative likelihood of the chosen completion. The reference policy supplies the regularizing anchor that ordinarily appears in RLHF, so preference data become the direct supervision surface rather than labels for a separate reward-model stage.

论文利用最优策略与其奖励函数之间的映射重新参数化奖励。所得偏好概率取决于策略相对于参考策略，对优选和拒选回答的对数似然比。

训练只需提高优选补全的相对似然。参考策略提供通常出现在 RLHF 中的正则锚点，因此偏好数据成为直接监督界面，而不是单独奖励模型阶段的标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
DPO receives prompt, chosen answer, rejected answer, a trainable policy, and a fixed reference policy. It computes the difference between chosen and rejected policy/reference log-probability ratios, applies a logistic loss, and updates the policy on offline minibatches.

Unlike conventional RLHF, the recipe does not first fit a reward model or sample new trajectories during fine-tuning. Reproduction therefore requires recording the preference-pair source, reference checkpoint, beta value, response-token handling, optimizer, and evaluation protocol.

DPO 接收提示、优选回答、拒选回答、可训练策略和固定参考策略。它计算优选与拒选回答的策略/参考策略对数概率比之差，施加逻辑损失，并在离线小批次上更新策略。

与传统 RLHF 不同，该方案不会先拟合奖励模型，也不会在微调期间采样新轨迹。因此，复现需要记录偏好对来源、参考检查点、beta 值、回答 token 处理、优化器和评估协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper evaluates sentiment control, summarization, and single-turn dialogue. It reports that the direct objective matches or exceeds the compared RLHF methods while avoiding a separate reward-model fit and online sampling loop.

The evidence establishes DPO as a practical training consumer for pairwise preferences, which explains its broad later adoption. It does not prove that all preference datasets are reliable: label noise, response length, and reference-model choice still change what the objective learns.

NeurIPS 论文评估情感控制、摘要和单轮对话。它报告该直接目标能够达到或超过所比较的 RLHF 方法，同时避免单独拟合奖励模型和在线采样循环。

证据确立了 DPO 作为成对偏好实用训练使用者的地位，这解释了其后续广泛采用。它并未证明所有偏好数据集都可靠：标签噪声、回答长度和参考模型选择仍会改变目标所学到的内容。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier RLHF pipelines learn a reward model and optimize a policy against it. DPO makes the policy/reference likelihood ratio itself the reward parameterization, so the same preference pair can be consumed by one stable supervised-style objective.

The contribution is not the collection of a new preference dataset. It changes the optimizer that consumes such datasets, making the pairwise record, reference policy, and beta coefficient the central reusable interface for a large family of later methods.

较早的 RLHF 流水线学习奖励模型并针对它优化策略。DPO 使策略/参考策略似然比本身成为奖励参数化，因此同一偏好对可由一个稳定的监督式目标使用。

贡献不在于收集新的偏好数据集。它改变了使用这些数据集的优化器，使成对记录、参考策略和 beta 系数成为大量后续方法的核心可复用接口。

title: Limitations
局限
html: DPO inherits the coverage and noise of its offline preference pairs and cannot repair a systematically biased data source. Its behavior depends on the reference policy, beta, response length, and the degree to which pairwise labels represent the desired deployment behavior. It also lacks the online exploration and explicit reward-model diagnostics available in some RLHF pipelines.
DPO 继承离线偏好对的覆盖范围和噪声，无法修复系统性有偏的数据来源。其行为依赖参考策略、beta、回答长度，以及成对标签代表期望部署行为的程度。它也缺少某些 RLHF 流水线所具备的在线探索和显式奖励模型诊断。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Read DPO before comparing preference-data selectors: it defines the standard way many later papers consume chosen/rejected records. Use it when an offline pairwise dataset and a reference checkpoint are available and a simple, stable alignment baseline is needed.
应在比较偏好数据选择器之前阅读 DPO：它定义了许多后续论文使用优选/拒选记录的标准方式。当拥有离线成对数据集和参考检查点、且需要简单稳定的对齐基线时，应使用它。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep the derivation, training interface, and data assumptions separate. The derivation explains why no explicit reward model is fitted; the interface specifies the pairwise records actually consumed; the data assumptions determine whether a good loss is optimizing the intended behavior. For replication, freeze the pair ordering, reference model, beta, and length controls before evaluation.
应将推导、训练接口和数据假设分开理解。推导解释为何不拟合显式奖励模型；接口规定实际被使用的成对记录；数据假设决定良好损失是否在优化预期行为。复现时应在评估前固定样本对顺序、参考模型、beta 和长度控制。
